title: Time Jump: Saturday 14:45, Final Sea Day

fields.jumpLabel: +6 hours 15 minutes of story time (from Saturday 08:30)
fields.narration: It is now 20:00 on the exercise clock, two hours after STARTEX. The story has moved to Saturday, February 20, 2027, at 14:45 Central ship time. This is the last sea day. MV Halcyon Dawn, Captain Anneliese Moreau, is about 330 nautical miles south of Galveston. Skies are clear, the wind is southeast at 14 knots and seas are 4 feet. Passenger case 90 has been signed. Whatever the ship and shoreside decided about the second special report, the flag state and the crisis team is now on the record, and you have to work with it. The 12:00 medical log, signed by Dr. Fiona Gallagher at 12:20, shows 98 passengers and 27 crew cumulative since embarkation. The medical center is almost full and gowns are running low. The family hotline has been busy all day, and a wire story about the ship is running on Houston news sites. The farewell show is tonight. At 07:00 tomorrow the Dawn arrives at a terminal where 2,980 guests for the next voyage have been told check-in opens at 13:00. For the exercise, the next hour covers Saturday afternoon through Sunday morning.
worldState: Clock: 14:45 Central ship time, Saturday, February 20, 2027. Final sea day, about 330 nautical miles south of Galveston. Clear, wind SE 14 knots, seas 4 feet.

Signed count: the 12:00 medical log, signed by Dr. Fiona Gallagher at 12:20, shows PASSENGERS 98 (3.3% of 2,980) and CREW 27 (2.4% of 1,120), cumulative since embarkation 14 Feb. This is now the only count any channel may quote.
Passenger case 90 (cabin code P-6218, 08:30) has been signed. Passengers passed the 3 percent threshold on Saturday morning.
Whatever the ship and shoreside decided about the second special report, the flag state and the shoreside crisis team is now final and on the record.
Lab: norovirus GII confirmed in 9 of 12 specimens (report ID-CZM-0218-114). The result does not change the count.
Medical center: 17 of 20 beds and all 3 isolation rooms in use. The Deck 2 forward isolation cabins remain occupied.
Supplies: gowns at 18 percent of stock.
Family hotline (800-555-0120: 640 calls logged today.
Media: a wire story headlined 'Norovirus confirmed on Galveston-bound cruise ship' is running on Houston news sites.
Tonight: the farewell show, the last night of the voyage.

Tomorrow: arrival Galveston 07:00 Sunday, February 21. Disembarkation is scheduled 07:30 to 10:30. 2,980 booked guests for the next voyage have been told check-in opens at 13:00 and boarding starts at 14:00.
fields.facilitatorNote: Before the next row, have every role show the count on its board as 98 / 27, signed 12:20 Saturday. Anything that still shows 87 / 24 (the 07:00 count), 90, or a figure from the posts is a finding. Make sure the 4-hour update to the VSP (due by 03:00 Sunday) and tomorrow's turnaround are on someone's list. Do not hint at what happens in the medical center later this afternoon.
